title: EXECUTION_ADAPTER_TRIO_V1 — local argv, Claude Code, and Cursor CloudAgent
mission: Turn AgentSwitchboard's dispatch seam into a provider-neutral execution-adapter layer and prove the first three native execution planes—local argv, Claude Code, and Cursor CloudAgent—without duplicating Prompt Kit semantics or FirstMate crew scheduling.
lane: shared contract, three isolated adapter lanes, then convergence
dependencies: PR #332 is the current Cursor implementation/evidence source and must be reconciled, not overwritten
safeParallelWork: EAT-301 may repair PR #332 immediately because it owns existing Cursor dispatch files and does not touch the new shared contract paths.
After EAT-005 lands, EAT-101 local-argv, EAT-201 Claude Code, and EAT-302 Cursor reconciliation are dependency-ready in separate isolated branches/worktrees.
Runtime proof lanes may proceed in parallel only with separate authorized host/provider resources and no shared fixture/evidence roots.
Documentation for later adapters may begin after EAT-402 without implementing a fourth runtime.
ownedScope: tests/test_execution_adapter_contract.py and later execution-adapter focused tests
scripts/Test-ExecutionAdapterContract.ps1 and later execution-adapter focused validators
forbiddenScope: Do not mutate PR #332-owned tooling/harness/triage-consumer/dispatch/** files from the shared-contract lane before EAT-302 reconciliation.
Do not move Prompt Kit prompt selection, semantic routing, recovery doctrine, or workflow meaning into adapters.
Do not create another crew/session scheduler or weaken the FirstMate canonical crew-runtime boundary.
Do not redesign tooling/evals/p67-opencode-adapter/** as part of this milestone.
Do not invent scripts/prompt_parallel_dispatch.py or a duplicate Prompt Kit orchestration subsystem in AgentSwitchboard.
Do not start interactive provider authentication from adapter probes.
Do not commit secrets, private host paths, tokens, raw provider transcripts, or machine-local runtime receipts.
Do not claim adapter runtime, provider delivery, deployment, or operator acceptance from contract/static CI proof.
expectedArtifacts: Closed execution request, receipt, and capability-report schemas
Deterministic semantic validator registered in the automated test floor
Generic adapter interface, registry, and runner
Claude Code adapter with CLAUDE_CODE_RUNTIME_OBSERVED proof
Cursor CloudAgent adapter with CURSOR_CLOUD_AGENT_RUNTIME_OBSERVED proof
Three-plane observed proof packet and extension documentation
Seven self-contained portability fallback sprint panels bound to the canonical issue IDs

tasks.title: Freeze execution-adapter v1 vocabulary
acceptanceCriteria: Adapter kinds, readiness dimensions, terminal statuses, blocker codes, proof levels, and ownership boundaries are explicit.
Prompt Kit semantic ownership and FirstMate crew-runtime authority remain outside adapters.

tasks.title: Define execution-request/v1
acceptanceCriteria: Closed request schema carries immutable identity, adapter kind, mission, cwd, timeout, mutation scopes, execution policy, adapter-specific input, and provenance.
Interactive authentication is forbidden by schema.

tasks.title: Define execution-receipt/v1
acceptanceCriteria: Closed receipt schema normalizes status, native execution identity, exit code, timing, artifacts, bounded output, blocker, and proof.
EXECUTED can be semantically required to carry native execution identity.

tasks.title: Define capability-report/v1
acceptanceCriteria: Probe contract distinguishes host, binary, auth, transport, and dispatch readiness.
Probe proof ceiling remains CAPABILITY_PROBE_ONLY and cannot silently promote runtime proof.

tasks.title: Implement generic adapter interface and registry
acceptanceCriteria: Adapters expose probe() and execute(request).
Generic runner resolves adapter through registry rather than native-harness if/elif execution branches.
Unknown/unready adapter fails closed with normalized receipt.

tasks.title: Implement legacy Triage receipt compatibility bridge
acceptanceCriteria: Existing Triage consumers continue receiving their current lane receipt shape during migration.
Translation does not raise proof level or convert BLOCKED/FAILED/TIMED_OUT into EXECUTED.

tasks.title: Extract local-argv reference adapter
acceptanceCriteria: Existing subprocess semantics move behind the generic interface without shell=True.
Generic dispatcher no longer owns local subprocess mechanics after convergence.

tasks.title: Implement local-argv capability probe
acceptanceCriteria: Executable resolution and cwd readiness are reported precisely.
Missing executable/cwd is BLOCKED rather than an uncaught exception.

tasks.title: Bound local process timeout and output
acceptanceCriteria: Timeout is enforced and terminally classified.
stdout/stderr excerpts obey deterministic request/contract bounds.

tasks.title: Prove local runtime success path
acceptanceCriteria: Real child process emits expected marker and exits 0.
Receipt records expected cwd, exit code, timing, identity, and validates.

tasks.title: Prove local runtime nonzero path
acceptanceCriteria: Real child process emits known stdout/stderr and exits 42.
Receipt is FAILED and preserves exact exit code 42.

tasks.title: Prove local runtime timeout path
acceptanceCriteria: Bounded hang is terminated/classified TIMED_OUT.
Timeout can never be reported EXECUTED.

tasks.title: Prove legacy Triage dispatch regression safety
acceptanceCriteria: Existing Triage dispatch validator remains green after extraction.
Protected local-argv control still captures exit code and output through the compatibility layer.

tasks.title: Implement Claude Code capability probe
acceptanceCriteria: Probe detects binary/version/headless structured execution and auth readiness without interactive login.
Unavailable binary/auth returns exact BLOCKED state.

tasks.title: Map generic requests to Claude Code invocation
acceptanceCriteria: cwd, timeout, resolved prompt, model/session choice, and execution policy are deterministic.
Adapter does not select or reinterpret Prompt Kit prompts.

tasks.title: Implement Claude execution permission profiles
acceptanceCriteria: Unrestricted permission bypass is not the default.
Effective profile and relevant native restrictions are included in execution evidence.

tasks.title: Implement Claude structured result parser
acceptanceCriteria: Native process result maps to normalized receipt without inventing session/model fields.
Available native session/runtime identity is captured.

tasks.title: Implement Claude negative-path fixtures
acceptanceCriteria: Each failure is deterministically BLOCKED/FAILED/TIMED_OUT.
No negative path can become false EXECUTED.

tasks.title: Build disposable Claude E2E fixture repository
acceptanceCriteria: Fixture allows one bounded expected file mutation.
Independent validator can prove result without trusting Claude self-report.

tasks.title: Prove Claude Code runtime end to end
acceptanceCriteria: ASB request launches real Claude CLI noninteractively.
Expected mutation occurs and external validator passes after Claude exits.
Normalized receipt validates with honest runtime identity/evidence.

tasks.title: Re-run local protected control after Claude integration
acceptanceCriteria: Local success, exit-42, and timeout controls remain green after Claude integration.

tasks.title: Repair PR #332 deterministic test-floor hygiene
outputs: green exact-head #332 floor or exact new blocker
acceptanceCriteria: Remove trailing whitespace defect family from #332 candidate without architecture churn.
Windows and Ubuntu automated floor rerun on exact repaired head.
Do not treat prior real Task launch as proof of a machine-closed production bridge.
evidence: Current failure evidence: test_cloud_agent_orchestration.py trailing whitespace on Windows and Ubuntu

tasks.title: Reconcile PR #332 with execution-adapter v1
acceptanceCriteria: Useful request/result and real Task evidence from #332 is preserved.
Generic shared contract remains owner of common fields; #332 transport details remain Cursor-private.

tasks.title: Implement Cursor capability probe v1
acceptanceCriteria: Probe separately reports host, transport, and Task dispatch readiness.
Socket existence alone cannot report dispatch READY.

tasks.title: Port #332 request/result transport behind Cursor adapter
acceptanceCriteria: Generic runner does not know filesystem/socket/provider details.
Request/result correlation is deterministic and bounded.

tasks.title: Machine-close Cursor Task dispatch bridge
acceptanceCriteria: No operator notices a marker/request or manually performs Task invocation.
One adapter request can cause Task launch or return a precise BLOCKED_API result.

tasks.title: Implement Cursor terminal result observer
acceptanceCriteria: Fresh CloudAgent identity and terminal completed/failed/timeout state return machine-readably.
Timeout is bounded and cannot become EXECUTED.

tasks.title: Implement Cursor negative-path coverage
acceptanceCriteria: Each unavailable layer maps to precise blocker/failure.
No simulated/mock completion is promoted to live proof.

tasks.title: Prove Cursor CloudAgent runtime end to end
acceptanceCriteria: One ASB dispatch launches a fresh real CloudAgent without human bridge.
Terminal state and cloudAgentBcId are captured automatically.
Independent expected artifact/result is verified.

tasks.title: Re-run local and Claude protected controls after Cursor integration
acceptanceCriteria: Cursor integration does not regress local or Claude adapter contracts/proofs.

tasks.title: Create common adapter conformance suite
acceptanceCriteria: All adapters satisfy one common probe/request/receipt/blocker/timeout contract.
Adapter-specific tests may extend but cannot weaken common semantics.

tasks.title: Remove native-harness branching from generic dispatcher
acceptanceCriteria: Generic dispatch resolves adapter by registry and calls probe/execute.
No local/Claude/Cursor native execution implementation remains embedded in generic dispatch branching.

tasks.title: Create cross-adapter bounded task fixture
acceptanceCriteria: A common high-level bounded task can be expressed through each compatible adapter without changing receipt semantics.

tasks.title: Produce three-plane observed proof packet
acceptanceCriteria: Packet links exact adapter identities and independent validator results.
Each adapter retains its own runtime proof ceiling; packet does not homogenize or inflate evidence.

tasks.title: Prove adapter failure isolation
acceptanceCriteria: Blocking one adapter does not poison registry or falsely block unrelated ready adapters.

tasks.title: Document extension contract for later harnesses
acceptanceCriteria: A fourth adapter requires implementation plus registry registration, not dispatcher architecture redesign.
No fourth adapter runtime is claimed or implemented by this task.

tasks.title: Run milestone acceptance and convergence gate
acceptanceCriteria: Required focused and repository gates pass on exact candidate.
Three adapters satisfy minimum independent E2E proof.
Milestone state and remaining deferred adapters are durably recorded without proof promotion.

proof.target: Accepted adapter contract floor plus durable parallelizable milestone backlog for three native harness adapters.
proof.achieved: Execution-adapter v1 policy, request/receipt/capability schemas, public-safe fixtures, semantic validator, automated-floor registration, and the complete 37-issue multi-agent milestone map are tracked in PR #335. Adapter runtime implementations remain successor work.
proof.ceiling: CONTRACT_STATIC only until adapter-specific runtime lanes independently achieve LOCAL_RUNTIME_OBSERVED, CLAUDE_CODE_RUNTIME_OBSERVED, and CURSOR_CLOUD_AGENT_RUNTIME_OBSERVED. Planning, schemas, fixtures, CI, and PR state do not prove native execution.

handoff.nextOwner: execution-adapter shared-spine owner, with PR #332 owner proceeding independently on EAT-301
notes: First shared successor after contract integration is EAT-005: implement generic adapter interface + registry + runner.
EAT-301 is independent and may repair PR #332 immediately; preserve its real Task launch evidence.
